newsitem.title: USA: Ascend Communications switch said a leader.
newsitem.headline: Ascend Communications switch said a leader.

text.p: Analysts described Ascend Communications Inc's MAX TNT wide area access switch as a breakthrough in remote access concentrators for big telephone carriers and Internet service providers.
They said the product's introduction on Tuesday was the reason Ascend's stock gained 2-1/2 to 54-7/8.

"The product redefines the standard for price/performance among remote access concentrators," said analyst Jim Parmelee at DMG Technology Group, a unit of Deutsche Morgan Grenfell securities. "It allows the carrier to scale their services more efficiently as Intenret access continues to proliferate."
Parmelee said the product should allow Ascend to continue to be the leader in the remote WAN access market.

Earlier Alameda, Calif-based Ascend announced the MAX TNT, which it said is the only wide-area-network acccess switch that concentrates both dial-up and dedicated network traffic in a single platform. It said the product could support 2,000 concurrent modem users.

Analyst Therese Murphy of Smith Barney said the market Ascend's product addresses is expected to grow from $1 billion today to $6 billion by decade's end. "It certainly looks like a very competitive remote accesss server product."
